subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split so `heartbeat.session` precedence is fixed first while Telegram DM default isolation remains a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: Current source supports the heartbeat precedence bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior affects existing users and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins without changing Telegram DM defaults in the same step.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default and accept the required docs, migration, and compatibility review in one broader fix.

options.title: Defer to broader heartbeat design
options.body: Wait for native per-session heartbeat scheduling before changing this path, leaving the current source-repro bug open longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins without changing Telegram DM defaults in the same step.

likelyOwner.reason: The heartbeat runner feature history and product-scope decision make this the strongest available maintainer-routing candidate from local history.
